title: Norway – Information technology services – Procurement of framework agreements for IT consultants
description: The Directorate of Fisheries would like to enter into framework agreements for IT consultants within 5 different competence areas/categories. We will hire the desired resources as needed for digitalisation. Several parallel framework agreements shall be signed for each of the five competence areas listed below. The tenderers who best fulfil the requirements in the requirement specifications within the different competence areas will be awarded contracts within the individual competence area(s) where the tenderer is best qualified. Tenderers can submit tenders for one, several or all of the categories. The awarding of framework agreements within each individual competence area will be undertaken independently of each other. One tenderer can, therefore, be awarded several of the relevant framework agreements, and for each competence area the Directorate of Fisheries will award framework agreements to the 3 best tenderers. 15 contracts shall be signed in total for the entire procurement. The Directorate of Fisheries will hold call-offs in the form of mini-competitions between suppliers with a framework agreement within each competence area, in order to find the most suitable resources to cover the need. The consultancy services are divided into the following 5 competence areas: 1. System development and technical testing 2. Technical project management within digitalisation and digital transformation. 3. Computer platform and information management 4. Operation of a digital platform (DevOps/SRE) 5. Local operations/cloud operation The service is provided by incorporating consultants into our already existing team who are responsible for both development and operation/monitoring and assist there with their competence and capacity. The framework agreements shall initially be valid from approx. 10.03.2027 and will have a duration of one year, with an option for a 1+1+1 year extension of the agreements. The estimated total value for the entire procurement is NOK 250 million excluding VAT. Need and value will, however, vary within the different competence areas. See the tender documentation for more information.

title: Totalrådgivning for 2 nye daginstitutioner med lavt klimaaftryk
description: Københavns Kommune ønsker at bygge to nye daginstitutioner på hver 5 grupper på Svanemølleholm Øst i Nordhavn på en fælles matrikel. Den ene skal bygges som CO2eneutral daginstitution og den anden skal opfylde kravene til lavemissionsklassen i BR 18. Kravene for de to daginstitutioner er dermed forskellige, men opgaven forudsætter, at der identificeres potentialer for synergier i både projektering, udførelse og drift. Kravene om lavt klimaaftryk forventes overholdt uden at gå på kompromis med kommunens målsætning om velfungerende, driftsbare institutioner, der opfylder brugernes pædagogiske behov både nu og i fremtiden. Opgaven omfatter arkitekt, landskabsarkitekt og ingeniørrådgivning i samtlige faser fra idéoplæg til 1 års eftersyn.

title: MLNRV3 (Artic X34) raitiovaunujen pysäkkinäytöt
description: MLNRV3 (Artic X34) raitiovaunujen pysäkkinäytöt Pääkaupunkiseudun Kaupunkiliikenne Oy järjestää RV Kalusto ja Varikko Oy:n toimeksiannosta tarjouskilpailun MLNRV3 (Artic X34) -raitiovaunujen uusien pysäkkinäyttöjen sekä niiden kiinnikkeiden hankinnasta. Vaunusarjan koko on 70 raitiovaunua. Näyttöjä hankintaan yhteensä 385 kpl, joista 350 kpl asennetaan raitiovaunuihin ja 35 kpl tulee varalaitteiksi. Näyttöjen kiinnikkeitä toimitetaan yhteensä 365 kpl, joista tulee 350 näyttöasennuksiin ja 15kpl varaosiksi. Hankinnan kohteena on MLNRV3 (Artic X34) -raitiovaunuihin tulevat pysäkkinäytöt ja niiden kiinnikkeet. Hankinta sisältää ainoastaan pysäkkinäyttöjen ja niihin kuuluvien kiinnikkeiden toimituksen. Yhdessä raitiovaunussa on yhteensä viisi (5) kappaletta pysäkkinäyttöjä. Näyttöjen sijainti raitiovaunuissa tulee olemaan kulkukäytävän yläpuolella katon rajassa. Näyttöjen tarkoituksena on välittää matkustajille tietoa seuraavista pysäkeistä ja muista matkustamiseen liittyvistä olennaisista asioista. Arvioidut toimitusajankohdat ajoittuvat vuosille 2027–2028. Toimittajan tulee kyetä toimittamaan näyttöjä ja niihin soveltuvia kiinnikkeitä, jotka täyttävät hankinnan vaatimukset. Tarjoaja suunnittelee osana tarjousta kiinnityksen näytölle (yksi kiinnike per näyttö), jossa on huomioitu liitteissä 3 ja 4 esitetyt tiedot ja vaatimukset. Tarjoaja vakuuttaa, että hankinnan kohteena oleva toimituskokonaisuus täyttää tarjouspyynnön liitteessä 3 asetetut pakolliset tekniset vaatimukset. Tarjottujen näyttöjen elinkaaren tulee olla vähintään viisi (5) vuotta ja niihin tulee olla saatavilla tämän ajan puitteissa korjauspalvelua sekä korvaavia näyttöjä. Jos kyseisen näytön valmistus lopetetaan, tulee siitä ilmoittaa vähintään kuusi (6) kuukautta ennen tuotannon lopettamista. Takuuaika näytöille on 24 kuukautta, ja sen aikaiset velvoitteet on kuvattu tarkemmin sopimusluonnoksella. Takuuajan ulkopuolella tulee olla mahdollisuus lähettää hankittavat laitteet korjattavaksi. The Helsinki Metropolitan Area Transport Company is organizing a tender procedure on behalf of RV Kalusto ja Varikko Oy for the procurement of the new stop display screens and their mounting brackets for the MLNRV3 (Artic X34) trams. The total fleet consists of 70 trams. A total of 385 displays will be procured, of which 350 units will be installed in the trams and 35 units will serve as spare devices. A total of 365 display mounting brackets will be supplied, of which 350 units are for display installations and 15 units are for spare parts. The subject of the procurement is the stop display screens for MLNRV3 (Artic X34) trams and their mounting brackets. The procurement includes only the supply of the stop display screens and their associated mounting brackets. Each tram is equipped with a total of five (5) stop displays. The location of the displays in the trams will be above the aisle, at the ceiling level. The purpose of the displays is to provide passengers with information on upcoming stops and other matters relevant to their journey. The estimated delivery dates are between 2027-2028. The supplier shall be capable of delivering displays and compatible mounting brackets that meet the procurement requirements. As part of the tender, the tenderer shall design a mounting solution for the display (one mounting bracket per display), taking into account the information and requirements presented in Appendices 3 and 4. The tenderer confirms that the offered delivery package complies with the mandatory technical requirements set out in the Appendix 3 of the invitation to tender. The service life of the offered displays shall be at least five (5) years, and repair services as well as replacement displays shall be available during this period. If the production of the display model is discontinued, the supplier shall notify the contracting entity at least six (6) months prior to the end of production. The warranty period for the displays is 24 months, and the obligations applicable during the warranty period are described in more detail in the draft agreement. After the expiry of the warranty period, it must be possible to send the procured devices for repair.,

Bygget er på ca 15 700 m2 og ligger i Maridalsveien 29 i Oslo sentrum. Det vil bli avholdt en befaring for samtlige tilbydere den 25.11.26, kl. 08.00, i Maridalsveien 29, 0175 Oslo.

title: Fv.420 Stykkene rundkjøring
description: Arbeidets art og omfang Prosjektet omfatter etablering av en rundkjøring på Stykkene i Lillesand kommune, i krysset mellom fylkesveg 420 og fylkesveg 402. Dagens kryssløsning er uoversiktlig og har høy trafikkbelastning, med en årsdøgntrafikk på om lag 6000–7000 kjøretøy og tydelige rushtidsperioder morgen og ettermiddag. Området fungerer som et viktig knutepunkt for trafikk inn og ut av Lillesand, og er samtidig en sentral skolevei med mange gående og syklende. Prosjektet er tegningsbasert med noen supplerende IFC format. Veg Tiltaket innebærer bygging av en rundkjøring med diameter på 40 meter, etablering av cirka 125 meter fylkesveg, 105 meter kommunal veg og 810 meter gang- og sykkelveg. Det skal også anlegges to busstopp langs fylkesveg 420. Elektro Innen elektroarbeider skal eksisterende kabler langs strekningen håndteres, og høyspentmaster samt luftstrekk skal legges i bakken. Dette krever tett koordinering med berørte kabeletater. VA-anlegg Det skal anlegges vann- og avløpsinfrastruktur langs gang- og sykkelvegtraséen i samarbeid med Lillesand kommune. Arbeidet omfatter blant annet etablering av ca. 200 meter grøft med spillvanns-, vann- og overvannsledninger, 165 meter grøft med spillvanns- og vannledninger, 195 meter grøft med vannledning og cirka 190 meter grøft med overvannsledning. Anskaffelsesdokumentene Det er konkurransegrunnlaget kap. A-E med vedlegg som fremgår under dokumenter i Hyyr som er det gjeldende konkurransegrunnlag. Ved motstrid mellom informasjon i konkurransegjennomføringsverktøyet og vedlagte dokumenter (konkurransegrunnlag, vedlegg), gjelder informasjon i dokumentene (konkurransegrunnlag, vedlegg) foran informasjon i konkurransegjennomføringsverktøyet Hyyr. Tilbydere kan se bort fra generert konkurransegrunnlag i Hyyr, dette er noe som opprettes automatisk i hver konkurranse.

title: Rammeavtale for anskaffelse av gravetjenester, Sigdal kommune
description: Anskaffelsen gjelder Rammeavtale for kjøp av maskin-/grunnentreprenør for Sigdal kommune. Sigdal kommune er eiendomsforvalter og byggherre. Kommunen ønsker å inngå inntil to parallelle rammeavtaler med maskin-/grunnentreprenørfirmaer til oppdrag av varierende omfang og karakter innenfor maskin- og grunnarbeid. Arbeidet vil i hovedsak dreie seg om graving og arbeider i forbindelse med reparasjoner og vedlikehold av kommunal vei (inkludert asfaltering, bruer, gatelys mv.), vann og avløpsinstallasjoner, samt grunnarbeider i forbindelse med byggeprosjekter. Leverandører skal dekke kommunens behov for stående beredskap i forbindelse med flom, ras og skred, akutte vann og avløpslekkasjer, skogbrann og andre uforutsette hendelser med behov for personell, maskiner og utstyr. Utrykningstid skal være under en time. Oppdragsavtalene vil være regulert etter NS 8406. For større vei, bygg- og anleggsprosjekter forbeholder oppdragsgiver seg retten til å lyse ut eventuelle tilhørende maskinentreprenørtjenester i egen konkurranse. Sigdal kommune kjøper inn maskin-/grunnarbeid for ca kr 4.000.000 pr år, kr 16.000.000 ,- i løpet av hele kontraktsperioden på 4 år. Angivelsen er basert på tidligere historikk og basert på et skjønnsmessig estimat. Estimatet må ikke anses som forpliktende for innkjøp etter rammeavtalen. Innkjøp av maskin-/grunnarbeid vil variere fra år til år i tråd med Oppdragsgivers behov.

title: Anskaffelse av rammeavtale for kjøp av pansrede biler
description: Anskaffelsen skal dekke Utenriksdepartementets og utenriksstasjonenes behov for pansrede kjøretøy av typen SUV og Mini-van, med ulike pansringsgrader og tilpasninger. Behovet skal dekkes gjennom inngåelse av én rammeavtale med én leverandør. Anskaffelsen gjennomføres av UD på vegne av utenriksstasjonene. Oppdragsgiver har ansvaret for personellsikkerheten ved alle norske utenriksstasjoner. Et konkret sikkerhetstiltak for å beskytte personell på utenriksstasjonene er pansrede kjøretøy. De aktuelle utenriksstasjonene er i områder hvor den sikkerhetsmessige situasjonen er av en slik karakter at personellets sikkerhet anses å være utsatt. Bilene skal kunne benyttes i områder med svært varierende veistandard og må derfor være i stand til å tåle store belastninger. Rammeavtalens varighet er 2 (to) år fra signeringstidspunkt, med opsjon på å forlenge avtalen i ytterligere 1 (ett) år av gangen inntil 2 (to) ganger. Avtalens maksimale varighet inkludert opsjoner vil være 4 (fire) år. Anskaffelsens estimerte kontraktsverdi over fire år er 60 MNOK ekskl. mva. Maksimal kontraktsverdi over fire år er 100 MNOK ekskl. mva.

title: Datadrevet støtte til aktivitets-, bemannings- og arbeidstidsplanlegging i Helse Sør-Øst
description: Helse Sør-Øst RHF planlegger å anskaffe en regional løsning for aktivitetsbasert bemannings- og arbeidstidsplanlegging. Formålet er å understøtte sammenhengen mellom aktivitetsplanlegging, bemanningsplanlegging og arbeidsplanlegging, og bidra til mer effektiv utnyttelse av personellressurser gjennom automatisering, beslutningsstøtte og datadrevet planlegging. Løsningen skal understøtte aktivitets- og fraværsprognoser, optimalisere ressursdisponering, redusere manuelle planleggingsprosesser og bidra til bedre samsvar mellom aktivitet, bemanning og arbeidsplaner.

title: Bakeritjenester Harstad kommune - Rammeavtale
description: Bakgrunn Harstad kommune har behov for å etablere en ny avtale for levering av bakeritjenester til kommunens enheter. Bakgrunnen for anskaffelsen er at tidligere leverandør har gått konkurs, og kommunen må derfor sikre videre forsyning av brød og bakervarer til den daglige driften. Kommunens enheter har behov for forutsigbare og stabile leveranser, herunder ferskt brød til blant annet skoler og institusjoner. Leveransene skal understøtte ulike behov mellom enhetene og bidra til enkel bestilling, god koordinering og rask håndtering av eventuelle avvik. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Harstad kommune skal anskaffe bakeritjenester for levering av brød og bakervarer til kommunens enheter. Oppdraget omfatter levering til alle relevante lokasjoner i kommunen, med tilpasning til ulike bestillingsbehov og leveringsfrekvenser per enhet. Leveransen skal omfatte et standard sortiment av brød og bakervarer, herunder både grove og fine brødtyper. Det skal også tilbys allergivennlige alternativer samt sesongvarer og øvrige bakervarer ved behov. Det er behov for både faste og ekstra bestillinger. Leveringsmønsteret vil i hovedsak være ukentlig, men med enkelte avvik mellom enhetene. Kommunen etterspør en leveranse som kjennetegnes av stabil kvalitet, ferskhet, høy leveringssikkerhet og en hensiktsmessig bestillings- og oppfølgingsprosess.

title: France – Heating, ventilation and air-conditioning installation work – MARCHÉS D’EXPLOITATION-MAINTENANCE PERFORMANCIELLE ET SERVICES ASSOCIÉS (MEMPSA) POUR 23 ETABLISSEMENTS PUBLICS LOCAUX D’ENSEIGNEMENT (EPLE) - SELECTION DES CANDIDATURES
description: Le présent marché est engagé par la Région des Pays de la Loire en vue de la passation d’un marché public global de performance (MGP) au sens des dispositions de l’article L. 2171-3 du code de la commande publique, sur 23 Etablissements Publics Locaux d’Enseignement (EPLE) appartenant à la Région. L’étendue exacte des prestations attendues sera décrite dans le DCE. Ces différentes prestations seront assorties d’objectifs chiffrés de performance mesurables, conformément à l’article L. 2171-3 du code de la commande publique. Ces objectifs seront notamment relatifs à : - L’amélioration de la performance énergétique sur chaque site ; - L’amélioration de l’exploitation-maintenance des équipements ; - Le suivi performanciel des sites.

description: Auf dem Baufeld zwischen "Lange Straße", "Am Kanonsberg" und dem Parkplatz "Am Bussebart" in Rostock lässt der Auftraggeber den Neubau des Volkstheaters Rostock errichten. Der Standort des geplanten Theaters befindet sich innerhalb des historischen Stadtkerns nahe der ehemaligen Stadtmauer / Kröpeliner Tor. Benachbart liegt das städtebaulich markante „Haus der Schifffahrt“, das im Jahr 1962 fertiggestellt worden ist. Der Theater-Neubau ist als Stahlbetonbau geplant; teilweise kommen aber auch Stahl- und Verbundträger/-stützen zur Ausführung. Der Lastabtrag erfolgt teilweise über wandartige Träger und Flachdecken in Ortbeton. Der Theater-Neubau ist als 4-Sparten-Theater mit einem Großen Saal (ca. 650 Sitzplätze), einer Raumbühne (ca. 200 Sitzplätze) sowie zwei großen und zwei kleinen Probebühnen konzipiert. Darüber hinaus werden im Theater-Neubau noch Räumlichkeiten für öffentliche Gastronomie in den Ebenen E3 und E7 angeboten. Das Theater verfügt über drei Untergeschosse; in der untersten Ebene (E-3) wird eine öffentliche Tiefgarage mit ca. 100 Kfz-Stellplätzen vorgesehen. Die Zu- und Ausfahrtsrampe ist auf der Nordseite zum Parkplatz "Am Bussebart" angeordnet. Auch die Ver- und Entsorgungsanfahrt liegt auf der Nordseite des Theater-Neubaus.

title: APN - EPC Procurement and Financial Advisory Services
description: ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE Standing Offer for Energy Performance Contract Procurement and Financial Advisory Services (with security requirements) 1. PURPOSE OF THIS ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform consultants of an upcoming Standing Offer opportunity. The purpose of this APN is to allow consultants to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential Standing Offer, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested consultants to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances. Please note that there is no guarantee that this Standing Offer will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. 2. DESCRIPTION OF THE PROJECT AND SERVICES It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted below. This is conditional upon funding approval by DND. APN Number: EPFS2601 Approximate Estimate: 800,000$ Anticipated Posting: January 2027 Description: Energy Performance Contract Procurement and Financial Advisory Services The Consultant will be required to provide “as and when required” procurement and financial advisory services in support of Energy Performance Contracts (EPCs). The services may include, but are not limited to, the following: Review and provide procurement and financial advice on the contractual documents including the Request for Proposal (RFP) financial evaluation criteria; Support DCC in preparing draft responses to financial questions from Proponents during the procurement phase; Review and provide advice on the financial evaluation framework to assess the Proponent’s financial capabilities; Assist DCC with the evaluation of the financial component of the Proponents proposals; Support DCC in the review and analysis of the financial proposal received following the feasibility study; Assist in the negotiation and finalizing the final terms of the contract. The objective is to select one (1) consultant capable of providing deliverables in both official languages (English and French). The estimated value of the Standing Offer is approximately $500,000 over an initial two (2)-year period, with the option to extend the Standing Offer for up to two (2) additional one (1)-year periods and to increase its value by an additional $300,000 at any time. The total estimated potential value of the Standing Offer is approximately $800,000 over four (4) years. 3. CONTRACT AWARD AND ANTICIPATED SECURITY REQUIREMENTS To be eligible for the issuance of a Standing Offer, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS). 4. Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing consultants early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, consultants that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, consultants are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number, as identified in Section 2 of this APN; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored, as identified in Section 3 of this APN. 5. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the consultants to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a consultant: has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation being advertised on MERX, has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package prior to the closing date indicated in the solicitation, and has submitted a proposal,   DCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Note – Consultants that do not submit a proposal will not be able to attain clearance through this sponsorship process. Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent or tenderer regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. 6. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Patricia Biernat Procurement Specialist Defence Construction Canada 819-500-8074 Patricia.Biernat@dcc-cdc.gc.ca 7. Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process  and does not provide any representations or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, the proponent agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to the proponent for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated sponsorship process.  Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. title: Mise en page, relecture, impression et livraison des documents relatifs aux votations et aux élections de la ville de Zurich
description:
La Chancellerie municipale, service « État-major, stratégie et droit », lance un appel d’offres dans le cadre d’une procédure ouverte relevant du domaine des marchés publics pour le mandat « Mise en page, relecture, impression et livraison des documents de votation et d’élection de la ville de Zurich ».


Le service « État-major, stratégie et droit » et le service « Votations et élections » sont responsables des documents de votation et d’élection. Celles-ci comprennent la publication relative aux projets soumis au vote communal (version principale, version en langage simplifié et publication numérique), les cartes d’électeur, les bulletins de vote lors des référendums, les bulletins de vote lors des élections, les éventuels dépliants ainsi que les bulletins de vote et les enveloppes de vote. Alors que l’organisation des cartes d’électeur, des enveloppes pour les bulletins de vote et des enveloppes de vote est externalisée à d’autres services de l’administration municipale, la conception et l’acquisition de la publication de vote ainsi que des bulletins de vote et des bulletins d’élection sont entièrement gérées par la chancellerie municipale.


Outre la rédaction et la mise en forme du contenu de la publication relative au vote ainsi que des bulletins de vote et des bulletins d’élection, la chancellerie municipale est également chargée de la mise en page, de la relecture, de l’impression et de la livraison de la publication relative au vote, ainsi que de la mise en page, de l’impression et de la livraison des bulletins de vote et des bulletins d’élection (y compris les instructions de vote).

title: Y1DA--561-24-600 Upgrade Mechanical Systems-C Level
description: This notice is for Solicitation Number 36C24226R0127, Project Number 561-22-600 Upgrade Mechanical Systems-C Level at the VA NJ Health Care System, East Orange, NJ. This shall be a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside. As a result, all SDVOSB's may submit an offer, which will be considered by the agency. This project is classified under NAICS Code 238220 and has a size standard of $19 Million. The Magnitude of Construction for this project is between $5,000,000 and $10,000,000. Scope of Work: The scope of work shall generally consist of, but not limited to the following: Project will renovate the existing C Level utility space located at C Level of Building 1 which will provide environmentally safe, comfortable, and compliant conditions for maintenance staff. The current HVAC equipment and plumbing systems are in poor condition causing continuous water & steam leakage. The improper function of pumps is leaving the pump-pit filled with water. Newly renovated space will optimize daily activities, routine maintenance of utilities and provide safe environment for maintenance staff at C Level at VA New Jersey Health Care System East Orange Campus. Contractor shall completely prepare site for building operations, including demolition and removal of existing structures, and furnish labor and materials to perform work for VA Project 561-24-600 Upgrade Mechanical Systems-C Level as required by AE drawings and specifications, including but are not limited to: Steam Header Replacement and Distribution Condensate & Steam Piping Modification and Replacement of PRVs, Hangers & Valves Architectural and Structural Modification to Condensate Pump Pit Modification to Supply & Exhaust Air and Repair of Outside Air Intakes Hazardous Material Remediation and Insulation Repair Mechanical Room Drainage Enhancement Improvement of Lighting and Electrical Panels Refinish Surfaces, Removal of Brine Residue, Overall System Tagging/Identification and Systems Monitoring, Safety & Security. The contractor shall also furnish all labor, materials, tool, and supervision necessary to perform work for VA Project 561-22-600 Upgrade Mechanical Systems C-Level, in accordance with AE drawings and specifications. Project Completion: 430 Calendar Days from Notice to Proceed (NTP). All other details and information shall be contained in the solicitation which shall be posted on www.sam.gov. The solicitation will be released on or about November 23, 2026. The response submittal address, date and time will be included in the solicitation. This project requires bonding and all responses/submissions to the solicitation to be posted later shall be emailed. No hand-carried bids will be accepted. All prospective bidders must be currently registered in www.sam.gov , and be registered and verified as a Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) in https://search.certifications.sba.gov/ at the time of offer submission and before award of this procurement. title: RFB to Lease the Joshua Brooks House
description: Summary of the Opportunity This Request for Bids (RFB) provides the opportunity for interested individuals and organizations to submit bids to the National Park Service (NPS) to lease NPS property for residential use (single family) at Minute Man National Historical Park under the following general terms and conditions. See attached �Draft Lease� for complete terms of occupancy. Property Offered for Lease Joshua Brooks House The Joshua Brooks House is located at 41 North Great Road, Lincoln, MA 01773. It is approximately 2,216 SF with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. It was built by Deacon Joshua Brooks circa 1780 and is situated on an approximately 0.75-acre site. The Joshua Brooks House has been completely renovated with an attached carriage house which could be used for a small car or bikes and kayaks. The first floor is spacious with a redesigned kitchen including new stainless-steel appliances, cabinetry and quartzite counter tops. The newly refinished floors reflect the natural light from meticulously restored windows. The first-floor full bathroom was recently renovated, and a new smart washer and dryer have been installed in the nearby mudroom. Two stairways lead to the second floor where there is a dedicated office, 3 bedrooms, and another recently renovated full bathroom. The house features a restored terraced seating patio overlooking Elm Brook and surrounding forest and active agricultural fields. Uses of the Leased Property This lease is most suitable for low-impact, non-transient, residential occupancy of the house. The lessee is authorized to use the property as an occupant of the house and must be willing to become a part of the National Historical Park�s relationship with the public by maintaining the historic and well-tended appearance of the structure and grounds. In accordance with the attached draft lease, the lessee is responsible for all utilities and routine maintenance. The lessor will perform basic maintenance of the property as described in the lease. Term of Lease The lease will have a maximum term of three years, and a minimum term of one year. Lessee termination rights (termination without cause) will begin 90 days before the end of the first year of the lease and continue until the lease expires. Please note: 90 days� notice is required for termination without cause. Fair Market Value Rent The lessee will be required by the lease to pay at least fair market value rent to the NPS. Based on the terms included in the attached Lease (Section 5. Rent), the minimum fair market value rent has been determined to be $54,000 annually, payable in equal monthly installments of $4,500 each month. The lessee shall pay to the United States as rent the sum of Fifty-Four Thousand Dollars ($54,000.00) per year as the base rent payable to the National Park Service and forwarded by the lessee to the Superintendent, Minute Man National Historical Park. Rent checks will be mailed to Minute Man National Historical Park, 174 Liberty Street Concord, MA 01742, attention Superintendent. The annual rent shall be paid on the 1st day of each month in advance monthly installments of Four-Thousand Five-Hundred Dollars ($4,500.00). Payment covering the first month will be submitted with the executed lease. Other Terms and Conditions None. Competitive Process This lease opportunity is open to all interested persons on a competitive basis. The bidder submitting a responsive bid offering the highest monthly rent will be selected for award of the lease (subject to a determination of financial capability and reference check). A responsive bid is a bid that meets the material terms and conditions of this request for bids (see attached lease terms). The bid must offer a rental amount that is no less than fair market value as stated above. If two or more bids are equal, a drawing shall make the lease award by lot limited to the equal responsive bids received. Initial and Rolling Bid Submissions Bids must be received by the date listed on the first page of this RFB and must be submitted electronically in the format provided on the following pages. A public bid opening will occur the next day after the Initial Bid Submission Deadline (or the following Monday if the deadline is on a Friday). If a winning bid is not selected on that date, the NPS will open bids every following Monday at 1:00 PM until a responsive bid has been submitted or until NPS terminates the solicitation. Authority This RFB is issued under the authority of federal law and regulations. The applicable law is found in United States Code at 54 USC 1021 and leasing regulations may be found in the Code of Federal Regulations at 36 CFR Part 18. This RFB and the offered lease are subject to and incorporate all terms and conditions of Part 18 as applicable. In the event of any conflict between the terms of this RFB and Part 18, Part 18 controls. For Further Information Please Contact: Mike McCarthy Administrative Officer Minute Man National Historical Park 174 Liberty Street Concord, MA 01742 Phone: (781) 472-0970 E-mail: mike_mccarthy@nps.gov NPS reserves the right at any time and in NPS� sole discretion, to cause or do any or all of the following: Waive or correct any defect or technical error as to form or content of this RFB or in any bid, response, proposal, or proposal procedure, as part of the RFB or any subsequent selection and negotiation process. Modify, amend, cancel, or suspend any and all aspects of the RFB and selection process. Reissue an RFB. Modify the scope of the Lease or the required responses or modify the components of the Lease. Request that Respondents clarify, supplement, or modify the information submitted. Extend deadlines for accepting RFB responses, or request amendments to responses after expiration of deadlines. Consider comparable projects owned, developed, or operated by a Respondent. The National Park Service and Minute Man National Historical Park The National Park Service and its Mission America�s National Park Service was created by Congress to �conserve the scenery and the natural and historic objects and the wildlife therein, and to provide for the enjoyment of the same in such a manner and by such means as will leave them unimpaired for the enjoyment of future generations.� Additionally, the Congress has declared that the National Park System should be, �� preserved and managed for the benefit and inspiration of all the people of the United States.� The National Park Service has as its overall mission the preservation and public enjoyment of significant aspects of the nation�s natural and cultural heritage. To learn more about the National Park Service, visit our website at www.nps.gov. This site includes information about who we are, our mission, NPS policies and individual parks. Minute Man National Historical Park Minute Man National Historical Park was created by an Act of Congress on September 21, 1959 �� to preserve for the benefit of the American people certain historic structures and properties of outstanding national significance associated with the opening of the War of the American Revolution�� The specific purposes of the park include: �� the preservation of the historic landscape along the road between Lexington and Concord, (2) sites associated with the causes and consequences of the American Revolution, and (3) the Wayside on Lexington Road in Concord �.� To learn more about Minute Man NHP visit our website at: https://www.nps.gov/mima/index.htm. title: 2027 Construction Inspection Services Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC)
description: Federal Highway Administration Eastern Federal Lands Highway Division Construction Inspection and Management Support Services (MATOC) Solicitation No. 693C73-27-R-000006 The Federal Highway Administration (FHWA), Eastern Federal Lands Highway Division (EFLHD), anticipates awarding up to four Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts for construction inspection and other professional engineering services for the administration, oversight, and design of construction contracts performed by EFLHD on behalf of various Federal Land Management Agencies (FLMAs). These agencies include the National Park Service, the U.S. Forest Service, the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, and the Bureau of Land Management within the continental United States and its territories. This acquisition will be solicited and awarded on a competitive basis and is being made under the North America Industry Classification Code 541330 via full and open competition with small business reserves, per FAR 19.112. Two of the four anticipated IDIQ contracts will be reserved for small business concerns, if qualified. The planned duration for each of the IDIQ contracts is a total of five years (one base year plus four option years). The shared capacity of the IDIQs will be $60,000,000. In support of onsite construction activities, the types of work the Architectural-Engineer (A-E) firms may be required to perform under this MATOC include but are not limited to: inspection and documentation of construction activities; monitoring contractor compliance with plans, specifications, and contract requirements; review of contractor submittals; coordination of materials inspection and testing; monitoring of safety and environmental compliance; preparation of daily reports and progress documentation; schedule monitoring; and other related construction inspection and engineering support services. Construction projects supported under these contracts may include roadway construction and rehabilitation; bridge repair or replacement; drainage improvements; erosion and sediment control measures; traffic control; signage installation; safety improvements; and other transportation-related infrastructure improvements. The REQUEST FOR QUALIFICATIONS (RFQ) - PHASE I should be issued on or about November 20, 2026. The due date for receipt of Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) will be specified in the RFQ. IMPORTANT SAM REGISTRATION AND PAYMENT REQUIREMENTS: In accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 52.204-7 (DEVIATION NOV 2025), prospective contractors shall have an active Federal Government contracts registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) when submitting an offer in response to a solicitation and at the time of award. To register in SAM, go to https://www.sam.gov. Annual contractor representations and certifications must be completed online at https://www.sam.gov. Also, FAR 52.232-33 requires SAM registration for payment. It is the Offerors' responsibility to check the Internet address provided as necessary for any posted changes to this pre-solicitation, the future RFQ solicitation, and/or amendments.

title: RFI - FEMA - Supply Chain Management System (SCMS)
description: FEMA�s Logistics Management Directorate, Logistics Systems Division, is conducting market research to identify commercially available cloud-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions and associated services to transition, implement, operate, maintain, modernize, and support the FEMA Supply Chain Management System (SCMS). The anticipated requirement supports disaster logistics operations, including order and inventory management; warehouse and transportation operations; asset and in-transit visibility; point-of-distribution support; supply-chain reporting; procurement and enterprise resource planning interfaces; and financial reconciliation. FEMA is seeking solutions capable of supporting routine operations and scalable disaster-response surge requirements. The anticipated scope may include transition and implementation services, configuration and integration, recurring SaaS licensing, operations and maintenance, help desk and technical support, cybersecurity and system authorization support, continuity of operations, training, reporting, and optional surge capacity. FEMA anticipates a cloud-based solution or service model with approved system-to-system interfaces and applicable security, privacy, accessibility, and safeguarding requirements. This is a Request for Information (RFI) issued solely for market research and acquisition-planning purposes. It is not a solicitation, request for proposal, request for quotation, or commitment by the Government. No contract will be awarded from this RFI. Interested parties should review the attached Draft Statement of Work, Vendor Streamlined Profile Matrix, and Targeted Market Research Questionnaire for complete information and response instructions.

The proposed contract action is for services for which the Government intends to solicit and negotiate using Other Than Full and Open Competition (OTF&OC) procedures in accordance with RFO Part 6.103-1, Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements. title: RFI - Mesh Knit Cloth Manufacturability
description: SYNOPSIS: This Sources Sought Announcement is to assist the US Army DEVCOM Soldier Center to identify potential sources to provide a Mesh Knit Cloth conforming to MC-PD-25-006, Rev 2, dated 19 November 2026. The Government requests that responses be submitted electronically to Trevor Scott, trevor.h.scott.civ@army.mil, and Jennifer Fernald, jennifer.l.fernald.civ@army.mil, by January 4th, 2027 by 5pm EST. Background: The Government (DEVCOM Soldier Center) is interested in implementing potential updates to the current mesh knit cloth used in the USMC Cold Weather (CW) Baselayers conforming to MIL-DTL-32740, and MIL-DTL-32741. The purpose of this RFI is to gather industry feedback regarding the ability to meet the requirements listed in MC-PD-25-006, Rev 2, to ensure manufacturability prior to applying specification updates. Description: Mesh knit cloth material updates include increased material stretch, weight, thickness, and aperture size. Specification changes are meant to enhance material performance by increasing moisture transport, air permeability, and insulation via micro air pockets. If increased material stretch is achieved, end item patterns will be modified to allow for a closer fitting garment resulting in improved fit and comfort. Specific Specifications: Requesting industry�s feedback regarding the ability to meet the requirements listed in MC-PD-25-006, Rev 2, for potential use in end items conforming to MIL-DTL-32740 (Drawers, Mesh, CW Baselayer), and MIL-DTL-32741 (Undershirt, Mesh, CW Baselayer). Deliverables: Company name, address, and point of contact information. Three (3) yard sample, at no cost to the government, with attached material description to include fiber content, construction and weight. If more than 1 sample is submitted, request that the pros / cons of each submission are noted. A micro purchase request for additional yardage may be requested within 60 days for testing purposes after initial review. Physical test data for each material sample submitted; test methods and requirement objectives are listed in Table I of MC-PD-25-006, Rev 2. Estimated price per yard with identification of full width. Verification that the fiber and material manufacturing are Berry Amendment compliant. Lead time for production: 0 � 15,000 yards; 15,000 � 30,000 yards; 30,000 � 45,000 yards. If unable to meet all physical requirements, alternate samples will be accepted for review. In addition to the above deliverables, request documentation describing which physical requirements have not been met and any benefits provided by the deviation. Government Furnished Property (Equipment/Materials/Information/Computer Utilization): N/A Interested parties are invited to submit a response to this Sources Sought Announcement. No contract will be awarded from this announcement. This Sources Sought does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. It is subject to change and is not binding on the Government. Further, unsolicited proposals will not be accepted. Funding is not available at this time. The Government has not made a commitment to procure any of the items/services discussed, and release of this Sources Sought Announcement should not be construed as such a commitment or as authorization to incur cost for which reimbursement would be required or sought. Response to this Sources Sought Announcement is voluntary and no reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this and any follow-on information requests. All submissions become Government property and will not be returned. Not responding to this Sources Sought Announcement does not preclude participation in any future RFP if any is issued. title: Sustaining PNT & Integrating with Development to Enhance Readiness (SPIDER)
description: This Request for Information (RFI) / Sources Sought Synopsis is issued by Space Systems Command (SSC) to determine the market capabilities of potential offerors to execute the contemplated Sustaining Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) & Integrating with Development to Enhance Readiness (SPIDER) contract. The Space Force has committed to sustaining and modernizing the existing, proven Global Positioning System (GPS) ground segment for the foreseeable future. The SPIDER contract is the anticipated long-term successor to the current GPS Control Segment Sustainment II (GCS II) contract. SPIDER represents a paradigm shift from pure hardware and software sustainment to a unified sustainment and continuous development integration model. The contractor must not only sustain the legacy ground systems but also continuously integrate developmental modifications from ongoing modernization efforts to support next-generation spacecraft and rapidly field critical warfighter capabilities. Please see attached PA-2336 Cleared SPIDER Request for Information for more.

title: Invitation to Industry: FIRES Threat Coordination Group on Adversarial Threats to Offensive Fires
description: The Headquarters Department of the Army (HQDA), Deputy Chief of Staff (DCS) G-2, invites eligible, cleared U.S. industry partners to participate in an in-person, classified Fires Threat Coordination Group (TCG) in Charlottesville, Virginia, from February 16�18, 2027. This engagement facilitates a classified, two-way dialogue between Government intelligence analysts and industry partners regarding emerging adversarial threats to offensive fires portfolios. Discussions will inform capability development, modernization priorities, threat modeling, and counter-UAS (C-UAS)/counterfire considerations in contested environments. title: Germany – Environmental monitoring other than for construction – Monitoring von FFH-Lebensraumtypen, Grünlandkartierung im Rahmen des Nds. Weges sowie Basiserfassungen
description: Die Auftragsvergabe dient folgenden Zielsetzungen: - Die Auftragsvergabe des Monitorings von FFH-Lebensraumtypen (FFH-Monitoring) dient in Rahmen der FFH-Richtlinie der Erfassung und Bewertung des Erhaltungsgrades auf den für Niedersachsen festgelegten Probeflächen (repräsentatives Monitoring) bzw. der Erfassung der im Totalzensus (Erfassung aller Vorkommen bei seltenen LRT) befindlichen Vorkommen im aktuellen Berichtszeitraum 2025-2031. Es handelt es sich um eine Wiederholungsuntersuchung, bei der für den überwiegenden Teil der Flächen Kartier-Ergebnisse aus der Vorerfassung vorliegen und zum Vergleich heranzuziehen sind. Der letzte Erfassungsdurchgang erfolgte überwiegend in den Jahren 2021-2023. - Die Basiserfassungen erfolgen im Rahmen der Umsetzung der FFH-Richtlinie und dient der Ersterfassung von FFH-Gebieten in Niedersachsen. Gegenstand sind die Ersterfassung der Biotoptypen und FFH-Lebensraumtypen (LRT), wobei der Erhaltungsgrad der FFH-LRT zu bewerten ist. - Die Auftragsvergabe der Grünlandkartierung erfolgt im Rahmen des Maßnahmenpakets des Niedersächsischen Weges und dient der landesweiten Erfassung der seit dem 01.01.2021 neu in den gesetzlichen Biotopschutz nach § 24 NNatSchG aufgenommenen Biotoptypen des mesophilen Grünlands (GM), des sonstigen artenreichen Feucht- und Nassgrünlands (GF) sowie der Obstbaumwiesen und -weiden (HO) außerhalb von FFH-Gebieten. Die voraussichtliche Gesamtauftragssumme für die nachfolgenden Lose beträgt insgesamt etwa 561.000 EUR (netto). title: NextSTEP-3 Appendix B: Moon Base Demonstrations
description: UPDATE: November 12, 2026 NASA is pleased to announce the release of Directed Call #3, Moon Base Data Gaps. The primary objective of this Directed Call is to identify missions, payloads, or data sets that can provide the data identified in NASA�s priority lunar data gaps.. Questions related to this call may be submitted until 5:00 p.m. CT on November 18, 2026. White paper submissions are due by 5:00 p.m. CT on January 4, 2027. IMPORTANT NOTE: Per the solicitation, total funds requested from NASA is required in the cover letter and price is required in the white paper. See previous Q&As that address level of detail on price. Failure to include price in the white paper will result in a noncompliance and the submission will not be evaluated further. UPDATE: October 9, 2026 Directed Call (DC) #2 Surface Mating Systems (SMS) White Paper Questions and Responses and Model Contract added to Attachments/Links. DC #2 SMS White paper submissions are due by 5:00 p.m. CT on October 16, 2026. UPDATE: October 2, 2026 NASA is pleased to announce the release of Directed Call #2, Surface Mating Systems. The primary objective of this Directed Call is to design and develop new SMS concepts, culminating in a ground demonstration by September 30, 2027. Per Section 7 of the Directed Call, questions related to this call may be submitted until 5:00 p.m. CT on October 6, 2026. White paper submissions are due by 5:00 p.m. CT on October 16, 2026. UPDATE: August 14, 2026 The remaining Q&As have been added under the Attachments/Links tab along with associated updates to the Solicitation and Directed-Topic Call 1. Updates in the solicitation and Directed-Topic call are in red font. White paper submission date for Directed-Topic Call 1 is August 24, 2026. UPDATE: August 7, 2026 NASA is actively working to finalize and publish responses to all questions and comments submitted under the Appendix B solicitation and Direct-Topic Call 1. Due to the significant level of industry engagement, and to better support offerors, NASA will release these responses in batches as they are completed. The first batch of responses is now available in the Attachments section. Additionally, NASA is extending the white paper submission deadline from August 17, 2026, to August 24, 2026, to allow offerors sufficient time to incorporate the released responses into their submissions. UPDATE: July 16, 2026 The final solicitation for Next Space Technologies for Exploration Partnerships-3 (NextSTEP-3), Appendix B, Moon to Mars Architectural Studies, issued under solicitation number 80MSFC26R0003, has been reissued as Appendix B: Moon Base Demonstrations and supersedes previous solicitation instructions. In December 2025, a national space policy was signed into place that emphasized America's leadership in space, including returning to the Moon, building a permanent base, investing in new technologies, and advancing lunar and orbital economies for future scientific missions. NASA�s Moon Base, located in the lunar South Pole region, will serve as the premier proving ground for deep space exploration, empowering scientific discovery and the development of advanced space technologies. Based on the preceding, Appendix B will now focus on phased implementation of Moon Base. NASA seeks to bridge the gap between technology development and mission operations, targeting concepts at technology readiness level (TRL) 6 and beyond. Industry partners play a critical role in addressing architectural gaps and risk reduction buy-down that create the knowledge foundation NASA needs to make informed programmatic decisions and strengthen its ability to achieve strategic exploration goals efficiently and effectively. To that end, NASA's Human Spaceflight Mission Directorate (HSMD) is actively embracing innovative ideas from industry partners through this Appendix B: Moon Base Demonstrations under the NextSTEP-3 Omnibus Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) that calls for industry-led demonstrations and special topic activities. This BAA uses a dual-path call structure: Directed-Topic Calls and Open-Topic Calls. NASA will periodically release specific Directed-Topic Calls to guide industry partners and promote focused innovation in support of Moon Base objectives. These Directed-Topic Calls are designed to address evolving mission needs and encourage proposals that advance technologies and capabilities critical to lunar exploration. NASA intends to also have Open-Topic Calls available at a later date to allow industry to propose concepts within the topics outlined above that are not part of any prior Directed-Topic Calls included within this announcement. Open opportunities are meant to capture innovative solutions from the broader industrial base and may result in a contract to any qualified organization. Open-Topic submissions with identical concepts as Directed-Topic Calls will not be evaluated. This announcement will follow a 2-step process for proposal submissions. Step-1 of the process is the submission of a White Paper. In Step-2 of the process, only invited proposers will be requested to submit a full project proposal. NASA intends to award Firm-Fixed Price contracts with performance-based milestone payments. All awards will be subject to the provisions of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and the NASA FAR Supplement (NFS). All questions regarding this solicitation should be submitted in writing, electronically to Brad Vest, Contracting Officer, at Bradley.D.Vest@nasa.gov no later than 5:00 p.m., Central Time (CT), July 30, 2026. Offerors are encouraged to submit questions as soon as possible for consideration. The Offeror shall courtesy copy (cc) hq-nextstep3appb@mail.nasa.gov on this communication. ________________________________________________________________________ The final solicitation for Next Space Technologies for Exploration Partnerships-3 (NextSTEP-3), Appendix B, Moon to Mars Architectural Studies, issued under solicitation number 80MSFC26R0003, is on hold until further notice. Offerors are responsible for monitoring this website for the reissuance of the solicitation and any subsequent amendments, if applicable.

title: Norway – Research and development services and related consultancy services – Socio-economic analysis of the VAT compensation scheme for NGOs.
description: The examiner shall carry out a socio-economic analysis of alternative models for any rule management of the VAT compensation scheme (the VAT compensation scheme) for voluntary organisations in accordance with the Review Instructions and DFØ ́s guideline in socio-economic analyses the analysis shall highlight the benefit, costs and distribution impacts for the state, NGOs and society as a whole, as well as assess consequences for goal achievement, administrative load, control needs and budgetary risk. The Norwegian Parliament has made a decision on governing the VAT compensation scheme. The current scheme is statutory, based on the Norwegian Parliament ́s annual budget resolutions. In order to fulfil the rule management decision, the financing must be altered from the current framework-controlled grant to an estimate grant. The grant regulations approved by the Norwegian Parliament state that an estimate grant must be pursuant to the rules set by the Storting, cf. § 5 second section no. 1. This means that the scheme must be anchored in law. The government is following up the Storting's decision by examining the basis for and the consequences of any statutory scheme. A rule management of the VAT compensation scheme involves a fundamental change in the management mechanism for the scheme. The grant schemes are normally based on the rights of the individual. title: Netherlands – Collection agency services – Inning Invordering Bezwaar en Beroep
description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europeesopenbare procedure conform de (gewijzigde) aanbestedingswet 2012. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Opdracht Een van de taken van de gemeente is handhaving op parkeren. De gemeente Breda voert deze handhaving in eigen beheer uit. Daarbij worden sinds 2019 scanauto’s ingezet. Hierbij worden naheffingsaanslagen uitgeschreven. Deze naheffingen dienen geïnd te worden. Deze uitvraag betreft de oplegging en inning/invordering van de door de gemeente uitgeschreven naheffingsaanslagen voor zowel Nederlandse als buitenlandse kentekens. Verder kan er bezwaar gemaakt worden tegen deze naheffingen. De afhandeling van deze bezwaarschriften en de afhandeling van eventuele daarop volgende beroepschriften vormen eveneens onderdeel van deze opdracht. Ter indicatie zijn hierbij de cijfers van 2025. Het betreft de volgende aantallen NHA’s: 132.968 NHA's De indicatie van de verwachte aantallen is ontleend aan de huidige situatie. Benadrukt wordt dat de omvang een indicatie is waaraan geen rechten ontleend kunnen worden. De werkelijke omvang van de opdracht kan dus in positieve of negatieve zin afwijken van de genoemde indicatie. Een doelmatige periodieke rapportage van de uitgevoerde activiteiten behoort eveneens tot de scope. De gemeente verwacht van de te contracteren partij dat ingespeeld wordt op nieuwe ontwikkelingen en wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving. Deze partij communiceert bijvoorbeeld proactief wanneer invordering in meerdere/nieuwe landen mogelijk wordt. De te contracteren partij verstuurt de NHA’s, waarbij de vormgeving in samenwerking met de gemeente tot stand komt, o.a. dat op de uitgeschreven NHA’s verwezen naar de uitvoerende partij voor de bezwaarmogelijkheden, dit dient in tekst en d.m.v. een QR duidelijk te worden. De gemeente zorgt ervoor dat op haar website verwezen wordt naar de bezwaarmogelijkheden bij opdrachtnemer. De gemeente is op zoek naar een partij die een snelle en efficiënte afhandeling van de invorderingsdossiers en bezwarencases kan borgen, waarbij klantvriendelijkheid hoog in het vaandel staat. Wetende dat niemand ‘blij’ wordt van een naheffing, is juist bij de klantcontacten een klantvriendelijke en waar nodig de-escalerende benadering voor de gemeente van belang. De gemeente Breda is momenteel bezig met het opstellen van een wielklembeleid. Momenteel is de gemeente bezig met de eerste onderzoekende fase. Het is mogelijk dat tijdens het contract of net voor het vastleggen van het contract meer informatie beschikbaar is over het invoeren van het wielklembeleid. Percelen Deze opdracht is niet verdeeld in percelen: Doel Het doel van deze aanbesteding is om voor de levering van deze diensten een raamovereenkomst te sluiten. De overeenkomst treedt in werking op 1 december 2026 en heeft een looptijd van twee (2) jaar na het moment van livegang op 1 maart 2027. De opdrachtgever heeft bij wederzijds goedvinden van partijen het recht deze twee (2) maal met één (1) jaar te verlengen. De besluitvorming ten aanzien van deze verlenging(en) geschiedt op basis van evaluatie van de geleverde prestatie. Maximale contractwaarde De maximale opdrachtwaarde in het kader van deze raamovereenkomst wordt gesteld op € 5.000.000,- bezien over de looptijd van de overeenkomst, inclusief verlengingsopties. Aan het genoemde bedrag kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. Voor opdrachtgever geldt geen afnameverplichting. Mocht gedurende de looptijd van de raamovereenkomst de maximale opdrachtwaarde worden overschreden dan zal de raamovereenkomst (eerder) worden beëindigd. Mercell Deze aanbesteding zal uitsluitend en geheel digitaal online worden afgehandeld via het Mercell platform (www.mercell.com). Een uitgebreide instructie met betrekking tot digitaal aanbesteden treft u aan in de Vragenlijsten.

description: 1. DESCRIPTION OF REQUIREMENT This is a Solicitation Synopsis issued by the Department of the Air Force, Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center (AFNWC/NIKM), Hill AFB, UT. This solicitation is for the production and delivery of flight test kit replenishment spares for the Flight Test, Telemetry, and Termination (FT3) Program. These kits directly support the Air Force Global Strike Command (AFGSC) Minuteman III (MMIII) Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) Force Development Evaluation Operational Test Launch (OTL) Program. 2. SOLE-SOURCE JUSTIFICATION The Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one source: The Boeing Company (CAGE: 0B0D7), located in Layton, UT, under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by RFO 6.103-1 (Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements). Market research, including a Sources Sought Synopsis (FA8214-25S-FT3PD) and Pre-solicitation Notice (FA821426RB004-PRESOL), concluded that Boeing is the only source with the unique technical data, specialized engineering expertise, and established manufacturing infrastructure required to meet the Government's strict performance schedules. Award to any other source would result in an estimated minimum duplication of $80M in costs and an unacceptable delay of at least three (3) years. 3. PROGRAM SCOPE & REQUIREMENTS The resulting contract is anticipated to be a Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) vehicle containing the following primary parameters: Quantity: Production and delivery of twenty-five (25) FT3 flight test kits. Delivery Schedule: Just-in-time delivery to Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA, precisely 120 days prior to scheduled Operational Test Launches (OTLs). Period of Performance: October 2027 through September 2035. Total Estimated Program Value: Approximately $955M (including potential future procurements executed under an approved Class J&A). 4. SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS & INTEREST This notice is not a request for competitive proposals, and a written solicitation will be issued directly to The Boeing Company. However, any responsible source that believes it can meet these requirements may submit a capability statement, proposal, or quotation, which shall be considered by the agency. Information received will be evaluated solely to determine whether to conduct a competitive procurement in the future. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. All responses must be submitted electronically to the Points of Contact listed below no later than the Response Deadline indicated in this posting.

title: Czechia – Construction work – D46 MÚK Držovice
description: Předmětem zakázky je rekonstrukce mimoúrovňové křižovatky MÚK Držovice na silnici D46 (E462), která v současném stavu nevyhovuje platným technickým normám ani požadavkům na bezpečný a plynulý provoz. title: France – Beach cleaning services – ENTRETIEN DES PLAGES ET DU LITTORAL
description: ***Le présent marché a pour objet, l'entretien des plages et du littoral de la commune de Roquebrune-sur-Argens et leur maintien en parfait état de propreté. Toutes les prestations du présent marché pourront être commandées à tout moment. L'entreprise devra mettre en oeuvre tous les moyens nécessaires à la réalisation des prestations suivantes : - Nettoiement des plages et du littoral : Cette opération comprend le nettoiement manuel des plages (de sables ou de galets), des criques, des ouvrages piétonniers divers (chemin des douanier, sentier, accès, mises à l'eau et autres cheminements), des grèves rocheuses, des ouvrages de protection des plages (talus, épis, sorties pluviaux...), ainsi que l'ensemble des secteurs se rattachant au périmètre défini au CCTP entre les limites de communes de Fréjus et Sainte Maxime. - Collecte des poubelles de plages et du littoral : Cette opération consiste à collecter les poubelles mises en place sur les plages, le long de la RD559 et du littoral Sambracitain (côté mer). - Le criblage des plages de sable : Cette opération comprend le nettoiement mécanique des plages de sable et des criques de sable se rattachant au périmètre défini à l'article 1.3.1. du CCTP. Cette prestation inclut la collecte et l'évacuation en décharge de tous déchets, détritus ou autres matières. - Le reprofilage ponctuel des plages et de leur accès à effectuer avant la période estivale et après les coups de mer ou fortes pluies (sorties de ruisseaux et pluviaux). - Gestion de la posidonie : Cette opération est à effectuer avant la période estivale et selon les besoins. En accord avec les préconisations environnementales, la posidonie sera déplacée sur la même plage, et stockée, par couches alternées posidonie/sable. - Gestion du volume de sable : Cette opération est à prévoir en amont de la saison et en fin de saison, le principe étant de constituer une réserve de sable en fin de saison qui permettra lors de la saison suivante " d'engraisser " les plages concernées. - Concassage des plages : Cette opération sera planifiée en amont de chaque saison en fonction des nécessités, afin d'améliorer la granulométrie du sable.

title: Czechia – Software programming and consultancy services – NADSTAVBOVÉ ŘÍZENÍ SSZ V ČESKÝCH BUDĚJOVICÍCH – DOPRAVNĚ ZÁVISLÉ ŘÍZENÍ
description: Předmětem plnění veřejné zakázky je realizace softwarových úprav, zpracování související projektové dokumentace a implementace nadstavbového řízení dopravy pro celkem 41 řadičů světelných signalizačních zařízení (SSZ) v 6 vybraných lokalitách na území města České Budějovice. Hlavním cílem je povýšit stávající systém řízení na úrovni oblastí na dopravně závislé řízení, které bude v reálném čase flexibilně reagovat na aktuální dopravní poptávku, klimatické podmínky, nehody či uzavírky. Součástí zakázky je kompletní návrh řídicích algoritmů a změn signálních plánů, jakož i dodání dopravní simulace včetně ex-ante vyhodnocení kvality navrženého řešení v rámci definované architektury stávající dopravní řídicí ústředny (DŘÚ). Nové nadstavbové řízení bude implementováno s plným využitím stávající infrastruktury a licencí zadavatele. Algoritmy budou naprogramovány v běžném programovacím jazyku (Python, JavaScript, C#, Java apod.) s využitím přenášení strukturovaných dat prostřednictvím JSON v rámci stávající licence VAPW na DŘÚ VRS 5000 Web. Systém bude pro komunikaci a přenos potřebných DI dat z externích modulů a dat umísených na ústředně, což umožní efektivní integraci stávajících zdrojů dat a dalších telematických systémů města, jako jsou strategické detektory dopravy a systémy pro preferenci vozidel MHD a složek IZS. Výsledné řešení musí prioritně zajistit zvýšení plynulosti a bezpečnosti provozu na hlavních pozemních komunikacích, zrychlení průjezdu veřejné dopravy, podporu cyklistů a chodců a celkové snížení negativních externalit z dopravy (hluk, emise). Dopravní data ze strategických detektorů nebo z DIŘC využívají formát XML. Pro vyloučení všech pochybností zadavatel uvádí, že předmětem plnění jsou výhradně koncepční, projekční a softwarové práce včetně následného testování a odladění algoritmu nadstavbového řízení a systému s využitím stáváních licencí a architektury řešení. Předmětem plnění se předpokládá dodávka dle navrhovaného rámcového rozpočtu, který vychází z Technického popisu řešení a Popisu současného stavu. Jedná se zejména o tyto položky pro SSZ a nadstavbové řízení: - Dokumentace pro 6 oblastí a 41 SSZ; - SW pro řadiče včetně odladění; - Nastavení DŘÚ pro nadstavbové řízení (NŘ); - Dokumentace pro vlastní nastavení a popisu algoritmu NŘ pro každou oblast a křižovatku; - Zajištění všech instalací na HW a na síti SMČB včetně předání licencí, a zajištění NŘ a vlastní dodávky a instalace SW z pohledu kybernetické bezpečnosti; - Návrh a implementace NŘ v každé oblasti řízení města na SSZ; - Ověření a ladění NŘ v každé oblasti řízení města na SSZ; - Simulace algoritmu řízení a ověření jeho dopadu na dopravu pro každou oblast a SSZ; - Vazba na vstupní DI data, jež jsou k dispozici na DIŘC a ústředně VRS; - Vyhodnocení a ověření simulace a ověření jeho dopadu na dopravu pro každou oblast a SSZ; - Kontrola, vyhodnocení a ověření včetně koordinace a školení. - Předání veškeré dokumentace DŘ pro SSZ, nastavení algoritmu, popis algoritmu NŘ, SW pro NŘ, nastavení simulace a veškeré potřebné dokumentace včetně manuálu. Toto bude předáno pro NŘ, jednotlivé SSZ a ústřednu a servery města. - Součástí předání budou veškeré potřebné SW, licence, zdrojové kódy, popisy a nastavení včetně potřebných rozhraní. Toto bude předáno pro NŘ, jednotlivé SSZ a ústřednu a servery města. Součástí zakázky nejsou žádné hardwarové zásahy, výměny řadičů, dodávky či modernizace technologických zařízení křižovatek, ani žádné stavební úpravy či zásahy do fyzické infrastruktury pozemních komunikací. Vybraný dodavatel je povinen provádět implementaci a ladění algoritmů s maximálním ohledem na zachování plynulosti provozu a bere na vědomí, že případné krátkodobé nestability v dopravní síti během testování musí být minimalizovány a operativně korigovány. Nové algoritmy budou na řadičích aplikovány formou nových signálních plánů tak, že původní signální plány zůstanou k dispozici jako záloha. Navržené algoritmy musí: - nadále umožňovat i ruční řízení v lokalitách řadičů, - nadále umožňovat preferenci MHD v odpovídajícím smyslu (tam, kde je zavedena) nebo další specifické záměry stávajícího dopravního řešení, a to v rámci nově stanovených scénářů oblastního řízení. Postup při implementaci vytvořeného dopravního řešení: Dodavatel má povinnost nejprve provést dopravní simulaci návrhu nastavení algoritmu řízení NŘ se stávajícími daty dopravního provozu a předvést funkci NŘ v simulaci zadavateli. Zadavatel poskytne potřebnou součinnost v předání potřebných DI dat, topologie SSZ včetně popisu formátu, v jaké data budou předána (rozhraní). Následně má dodavatel jako součást realizační fáze díla povinnost doladit/upravit dopravní řešení na základě předvedené simulace a připomínek zadavatele, provést opětovné předvedení zadavateli a až následně spustit upravené dopravní řešení v reálném provozu. Během reálného provozu dopravního řešení v období 6 měsíců od spuštění má dodavatel jako součást realizační fáze díla povinnost 2× doladit/upravit dopravní řešení (ve lhůtě max. 30 dní od doručení požadavku zadavatele) na základě požadavku a připomínek zadavatele. Nabídka musí být naceněna tak, aby pro každý řadič SSZ obsahovala 1× optimalizaci algoritmu na základě předvedené simulace a 2× optimalizaci algoritmu na základě reálného provozu v období 6 měsíců od spuštění příslušného SSZ. Tato činnost je součástí rozpočtu pro dodávku (jako součást položky „zkušební provoz“). Blíže viz zadávací dokumentace.

title: Ateriapalvelut ryhmäkoteihin
description: Ateriapalvelut ryhmäkoteihin HUS-Yhtymä (jäljempänä HUS tai tilaaja tai hankintayksikkö) pyytää tarjouksia ateriapalveluista ryhmäkoteihin. Hankinnan kohteeseen sisältyy ruokien valmistaminen palveluntuottajan toimipisteessä ja ruokien kuljettaminen Tilaajan toimipisteisiin. Hankinnan kohteena olevia toimipisteitä on kolmessa (3) eri kaupungissa: -Lahden kehitysvammapsykiatrian yksikkö ja Lahden kehitysvammapsykiatrian lasten osasto -Hämeenlinnan kehitysvammapsykiatrian yksikkö ja Hämeenlinna Atrium -Järvenpään nuorisopsykiatrian yksikkö Lahden ja Hämeenlinnan toimipisteissä tarjoillaan viikon jokaisena seitsemänä päivänä (ma-su) aamupala, lounas, välipala, päivällinen ja iltapala. Aamupala ja iltapala toteutetaan välitystuotteina. Lounas, välipala ja päivällinen toteutetaan aterioina. Järvenpään toimipisteessä tarjoillaan ainoastaan arkipäivisin (ma-pe) aamupala, lounas ja välipala. Aamupala toteutetaan välitystuotteina. Lounas ja välipala toteutetaan aterioina. Ateriat toimitetaan kylmänä kaikkiin toimipisteisiin. Kyseessä on kokonaishankinta, eli hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin. Hankintayksikkö valitsee yhden (1) palveluntuottajan toteuttamaan koko hankinnan yhtenä kokonaisuutena. Hankintayksikkö voi jättää hankinnan jakamatta osiin, jos se hankinnan luonteen ja laajuuden tai palvelun toteuttamistavan, hankintakokonaisuuden hallittavuuden ja kokonaisvastuun taikka jakamiseen liittyvien riskien vuoksi ei olisi perustellusta syystä mahdollista. Hankintayksikkö voi jättää hankinnan jakamatta osiin myös, jos tarve koordinoida osien eri sopimuskumppaneita voisi vakavasti vaarantaa sopimuksen asianmukaisen toteuttamisen. Lisäksi osiin jakaminen ei välttämättä ole tarkoituksenmukaista silloin, kun liian pieniin osiin jakaminen voi johtaa vaikeasti hallittavaan kokonaisarkkitehtuuriin tai kustannusten jatkuvaan kasvuun. Markkinavuoropuhelussa saadun palautteen perusteella hankintayksikkö on arvioinut, että hankinnan toteuttaminen yhtenä kokonaisuutena on tarkoituksenmukaista. Markkinatoimijoiden näkemyksen mukaan yhtenä kokonaisuutena toteutettava hankinta muodostaa palveluntuottajien näkökulmasta kiinnostavamman ja liiketoiminnallisesti tarkoituksenmukaisemman kokonaisuuden kuin esimerkiksi toimipistekohtaisesti osiin jaettu hankinta. Hankintayksikkö arvioi lisäksi, että yhtenä kokonaisuutena toteuttaminen mahdollistaa palvelun ja kuljetusten kokonaisvaltaisen suunnittelun sekä keskittää palvelun toteuttamista koskevan vastuun yhdelle palveluntuottajalle. Hankintayksikkö katsoo edellä mainituilla perusteilla, ettei hankinnan jakaminen osa-alueisiin ole tässä hankinnassa tarkoituksenmukaista. Hankinnan ennakoitu arvo on 1 000 000 € neljän (4) vuoden mukaan laskettuna (alv 0%). Sopimuskausi on kahden (2) vuoden määräaikainen, jonka jälkeen sopimus jatkuu toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Suunniteltu sopimuskauden aloitus on 11.5.2027. Kyseessä on Liitteen E mukainen muu erityinen palveluhankinta. Hankinnan kohde ja siihen liittyvät pakolliset vaatimukset on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. Hankintalain 65 §:n mukaisesti hankintayksikkö on ennen hankintailmoituksen julkaisemista kuullut alalla toimivia yrityksiä. Hankinnasta on julkaistu tietopyyntö Hilma-palvelussa 3.6.2026 (Ilmoituksen Hilma-numero 2026-050527). Hankintayksikkö on kesällä ja syksyllä 2026 käynyt tietopyyntöön ilmoittautuneiden markkinatoimijoiden kanssa sähköpostitse keskustelua. Keskusteluissa hankintayksikkö on mm. kartoittanut markkinatoimijoiden näkemyksiä hankinnan jakamisesta osiin tai toteuttamisesta yhtenä kokonaisuutena sekä markkinatoimijoille mieluisinta tapaa hankinnan kohteen toteuttamiseen. Lisäksi hankintayksikkö on antanut tietopyyntöön ilmoittautuneille markkinatoimijoille mahdollisuuden kommentoida alustavaa luonnosta tarjouspyynnöstä ennen sen virallista julkaisua. title: Ilmanvaihtosuodattimet -puitejärjestely
description: Ilmanvaihtosuodattimet -puitejärjestely Hankinnan kohteena ovat kaikkien ilmanvaihtokoneiden suodattimet puitejärjestely, jotka kohdistuvat Pääkaupunkiseudun Kaupunkiliikenne Oy:n (KLOY), Helsingin kaupungin liikenneliikelaitoksen (HKL), Länsimetro Oy:n (Länsimetro), Ruskeasuon Varikkokiinteistö Oy:n, Sammalvuoren Metrovarikko Oy:n (SMV), RV Kalusto ja Varikko Oy:n (KAVA) sekä Helsingin Joukkoliikenneinfra Oy:n (jäljempänä yhdessä Tilaaja) omistamiin tai ylläpitovastuulla oleviin tiloihin, rakennuksiin ja kiinteistöihin. Tilaajat tekevät jokainen itsenäisen hankintapäätöksen ja allekirjoittavat omat hankintasopimukset tarjouskilpailun perusteella valittavien Toimittajien kanssa. Selvennyksen vuoksi todetaan, että Kaupunkiliikenne edustaa kaikkia Tilaajia sopimuksen mukaisten palveluiden suorittamiseen liittyvissä asioissa. Puitejärjestely ei sisällä määrä- tai vähimmäisostovelvoitetta eikä se tuota toimittajalle yksinoikeutta hankinnan kohteena olevien ilmanvaihtosuodattimien tuottamiseen Tilaajalle. Tilaaja hankkii ilmanvaihtosuodattimia tarpeen mukaan erillisten tilausten perusteella. Tarjouskilpailun perusteella puitejärjestelyyn valitaan enintään kolme (3) toimittajaa edullisuusjärjestyksen mukaan. Edullisuusjärjestys määräytyy Liitteen 1 kokonaisvertailuarvon mukaan, pienin vertailuluku on paras. Puitejärjestelyn sisäiset hankinnat tehdään etusijajärjestyksen perusteella. 1.Toimittaja tarkoittaa puitejärjestelyssä etusijajärjestyksen mukaan ensimmäiseksi sijoittunutta Toimittajaa. 2. Toimittaja tarkoittaa puitejärjestelyssä etusijajärjestyksen mukaan toiseksi sijoittunutta Toimittajaa. 3. Toimittaja tarkoittaa puitejärjestelyssä etusijajärjestyksen mukaan kolmanneksi sijoittunutta Toimittajaa. Tilaaja tekee toimitusta koskevat tilaukset pääsääntöisesti 1. Toimittajalta. Puitejärjestelyn toimintaperiaate on kuvattu sopimuksella kohdassa 3. Tarkempi tuoteluettelo esitetään liitteessä 1 Tarjouslomake. Kohteet sijaitsevat pääkaupunkiseudulla, jossa ulkoilman hiukkaskuormitus on korkea mm. liikenteen, katupölyn ja jatkuvan rakentamisen vuoksi. Hankinnan tavoitteet ovat järjestelmien likaantumisen, huoltovälien ja toimintariskien vähentäminen koko elinkaaren aikana kuin myös korkealaatuinen sisäilma, energiatehokkuus ja vastuullisuus huomioiden suodattimien koko elinkaaren ympäristövaikutukset sisältäen valmistuksen, käytön ja hävityksen. Näistä syistä esisuodattimen vähimmäisvaatimukseksi on asetettu Coarse 80 %. Suodattimet on testattava ja luokiteltava SFS-EN ISO 16890 -standardin mukaisesti (ePM1/ePM2,5/ePM10) tai Tarjoajan on muulla luotettavalla tavalla osoitettava, että tuote täyttää vähintään vastaavat suorituskykyvaatimukset. Sopimuskausi on kaksi (2) vuotta. Tilaajilla on oikeus jatkaa sopimusta kahdella (2) kahden (2) vuoden optiokaudella (yht. enintään 6 vuotta).
